prompt:
Locked-off camera on a tripod. A busy night in Times Square: the giant screen keeps playing its broadcast, the red band beneath it holds steady. People in the street stand gazing up at the screen, holding their phones up to film it, a few point up at it and turn to the person beside them. The yellow cabs wait with headlights on, a fine drizzle sparkles under the street lamps. Gentle movement continues right to the last frame. Sound: a big city crowd murmuring, traffic, a far-off siren. No dialogue, no music.

Thanks.
